title: Duelmania.fi
wikitext:
== Introduction ==
After [[Duelmania 3]] the admins decided to try something different. In [[Duelmania True masters]] 32 players would compete in a single-elimination tournament and those 32 players would be chosen from each country by arranging national duelmania tournaments. Duelmania.fi was Finland's qualification tournament. The tournament was succesful as 87% of the games were played and pretty much all the best active Finnish duelers were participating. Unlike in Duelmania 3 and all the other big duel tournaments to follow, ztndm3 was replaced by skull in the map pool. Skull had already been played in a custom map duel tournament before and it spiced things up very nicely for Duelmania.fi aswell. Especially [[Rat]] and [[Milton]] fancied skull over other maps.

== Settings, Rules, Maps ==
* Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]], [[aerowalk]], [[skull]]
* Time limit: 10 minutes
* Overtime 3 minutes
* Deathmatch mode 3
* No Powerups
* Discharges enabled
